extraction.scope: Section 3.1 of the ministry guide defines total facility energy, including electricity, fuels and other energy used for cooling. Each figure applies to the named register facility.

sources.date_semantics: The annual directory publishes the latest reporting year. The register’s statistics select 2025 and show that the reported period ends in 2025. Section 3 of the ministry guide defines the last full calendar year, so these figures are dated 31 December 2025.
